svg.title: Where to start, in order of payoff for the effort. First, hybrid search: it fixes misses on exact labels like tickers and codes, and running both searches at the same time adds almost no waiting. Second, reranking: the biggest quality boost, and the only step that lets the system say "nothing found". Third, HyDE: it helps most with short or vague questions, but it is the slowest step and the first to drop if the app feels slow. Every step can go wrong quietly, so watch each one.
